# Skinning arithmetic erratum — GT-S11 and GT-S18

**Confirmed correction:** replace **191 component occurrences / 108 consumed rows** in both GT-S11 and GT-S18 with **192 component occurrences / 109 consumed rows**. The correct breakdown is **83 nonconsumed tool rows + 109 consumed rows: 54 material, 35 solvent and 20 stabilizer; zero consumed-tool rows and zero catalysts**. Independent summation of the supplied 43 per-recipe counts gives 192/109/83, with every row satisfying total = consumed + nonconsumed.

This corrects the two tally statements and their corresponding validation expectations only. Preserve the original GT-S verdict as historical; change no ingredient occurrence, recipe register entry, body/effect mapping, price, source field or operational decision to fit the old tally. The mounted original Skinning verdict matches the supplied SHA-256 `a1fc285c49c91a3c9d977c988f7ff0266a481c633df0ae333429b1b26973c7e0` and is not overwritten by this erratum.

---

# Salvaging and shared gathering interfaces — GT-V source-authoring verdict

**Audience: internal source conference. Status: finite authoring directions, not exact operational-card approval.**

This verdict covers **all 42 Salvaging originals, recipe-433–470 and recipe-668–671**, all six physical families and every printed recovery percentage. Their allocation remains **25 public, two restricted and fifteen Director-only**. All 128 gathering-tool cards remain pending. Reviewed totals remain **392/687, with 295 remaining; public 251/433, with 182 remaining**. **Zero promotions are authorized by this source verdict.**

## Evidence, precedence and scope

**A1** means Part A’s crafting/harvesting/preservation framework, including its specific basic dismantling exception. **A2** means Part A’s trade, equipment, body/custody, Core resolution and creature-lifecycle rules. **A3** means its completed Fishing rules within their own scope. **B** means Part B’s shared evidence and GT-01–32. **D1** means this dispatch’s complete Salvaging COMMON/overrides; **D2** its 25 full public-book bindings; **D3** its structural register. **M** means GT-M01–18. **S** means GT-S01–18 with the arithmetic erratum above.

D1 identifies mechanical source SHA-256 `32b2bf00c28584ad259c343bc5b961126d25078c094444c05bf3caf0c9edda5e`; D2 identifies book SHA-256 `38eac505991a944ea557afa27751f510f773744734dc7a8e84c52b9bf7dcb099`. Those are supplied source identifiers, not new claims that the repository/books were independently rehashed here. The two mounted prior verdicts were consulted; the supplied protected-input and local-check reports are not relabeled as this reviewer’s independent retest.

Every **NEW** provision is an explicit authoring completion. Preserve the originals, including absent/null fields, component occurrences, duplicated resultItem mechanics, legacy effects/values, discovery, matrixResearch, visibility, guidance, developed and needsReview fields. No source field is overwritten to make it appear to have contained these decisions.

**No GT-M operational direction is changed. No GT-S operational direction is changed; its two component tallies are corrected.** The new Salvaging critical bridge, recovery calculation, component-preparation attribute and physical bodies are expressly Salvaging-scoped. Their differences from Mining/Skinning are stated below and must survive the joint reconciliation.

## GT-V01 — Dispose of every printed effect

**Affected: all 42 recipes. Sources: D1–D3.**

| Group | Exact recipes | Salvaging bonus | Recovery ceiling | Critical component-quality step |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| A | 433–445 | +1 | 25% | None |
| B | 446–455, 668 | +1 | 35% | None |
| C | 456–461 | +2 | 45% | None |
| D | 462–466, 669 | +2 | 55% | One eligible recovered component |
| E | 467–469 | +3 | 65% | One eligible recovered component |
| F | 470, 670, 671 | +3 | 75% | One eligible recovered component |

Recipe numbers in this document carry the `recipe-` prefix. The group counts are **13/11/6/6/3/3**, totaling42. Bonuses split **24 at +1, twelve at +2 and six at +3**. Twelve recipes print the critical quality clause. **There are no Salvaging extraYield omissions to repair.** Do not add a Mining/Skinning extraYield1/2 benefit, or insert an absent source field as though it were printed.

All six printed percentages operate as **replacement total recovery ceilings**, not additions to the ordinary25%, chance rolls, percentages of value or a second pass over leftovers. A25% tool retains a useful qualifying check bonus without increasing the ordinary25% quantity. Recovery applies on a successful lawful dismantling, not just on a critical; the quality clause alone requires GT-V04’s specific critical bridge.

The numerical bonus has the bounded task scope in GT-V02. Percentage and quality effects are **dismantling-only**. They do not increase manufacturing output, failure-input recovery, generic construct-remains yield, creature drops, prospecting, refining, research or repair.

Tags, tier and names are recipe identity here, not matching-target requirements or extra powers. Fire/Cold/Water/Poison/Arcane/Unholy/Stealth and secondary tags supply no heat, refrigeration, immunity, resistance, telepathy, invisibility, Strength or essence-handling authority. Legacy combat, spell-like, unique-power and “Godlike” wording remains inactive. High price, tier or rarity does not classify the result as an artifact.

## GT-V02 — Credentials, qualifying checks and separate tasks

**Affected: all 42 recipes. Sources: A1–A2; the exact item-bonus predicates are NEW.**

Use the **non-artisan Salvager’s-tools credential**, choosing **INT or WIS** before work. Apply the current actual lead’s ability and one applicable PB contribution; applicable expertise replaces that contribution. Do not add trade level, the maker’s statistics, both Engineering and tool PB, or an assistant’s item bonus.

Both basic and tool-assisted mundane dismantling require **actual Salvager’s-tools proficiency**. Owning the kit or enchanted item does not supply it. A trained level1 user can use a legitimately acquired high-level finished tool on a lawful dismantling without owning its formula; an untrained buyer cannot bypass the dismantling proficiency requirement. Creation keeps its different level/formula gates.

**NEW item-bonus scope:** the bonus may assist (a) the tool-assisted mundane dismantling procedure below, or (b) an independently lawful generic extraction of ordinary construct remains using Salvaging, with actual compatible family work. On route(b), only the numerical bonus applies. The percentage/quality clauses do not cross over. A genuinely different named source procedure must explicitly establish compatibility before benefiting; a task label alone is insufficient.

**Excluded:** recipe creation, formula research/copying, item identification, creature-type identification, Engineering diagnosis, commercial appraisal, post-recovery sorting/cleaning/refining, smelting, chemical purification, preservation, repair/reconstruction, harvesting biological creatures by ingredient analogy, combat, general Forage and magical/unique target dismantling without its own completed profile. The finished tools do not improve their own production or restoration.

An artisan-only proficiency choice cannot select Salvager’s tools. **Forge Dwarf’s artisan creation time/quality benefits apply to none of these Salvaging creations, uses or restoration tasks.** Explicit source grants retain their real scope; ownership gives no free kit, training, recipe or trade XP.

**NEW dismantling worker limit:** one trained lead performs the full sixty active minutes. There is **no generic dismantling assistant bonus or time reduction**. Other capable workers may do actual lifting, guarding or cargo handling in their own compatible time, but that does not substitute for the lead’s hands/work or donate their enchanted tools’ effects. This fills the dismantling assistant gap without importing the harvesting assistant rule.

Ordinary construct-remains extraction instead retains A1’s one eligible trained assistant for+1 and actual full extraction time. **NEW explicit untrained binding for that route only:** where A1 permits an otherwise feasible unranked extraction, an untrained lead uses INT/WIS without tool PB and with disadvantage. This does not authorize untrained dismantling or restricted material access.

## GT-V03 — Six finite complete-body bindings

**Affected: exact family sets below. The ordinary Salvaging Kit price/mass/capacity are retained from A2; its decomposition and every other body profile below are NEW.**

Each lawful finished output is one **durable magical nonartifact tool**, Standard equipment grade, without attunement, charges, RP, concentration or a separate magic-activation Action. Each model has **ordinary structural HP5**; these are tool bodies, not vehicles or autonomous creatures. All dimensions are fixed. No automatic Large sizing, magical strength multiplier, hoisting permission or weapon profile is granted.

| Code / family | Exact recipes | Mundane body gp | Empty lb | Structural HP / AC |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| F — Refiner | 433, 441, 447, 451, 454, 461, 469 | 10 | 6 | 5 / 19 |
| K — Salvaging Kit | 434, 445, 449, 453, 457, 458, 460, 468, 668 | 25 | 5 | 5 / 19 |
| S — Separator | 435, 436, 437, 440, 446, 448, 455, 466, 669, 671 | 15 | 8 | 5 / 19 |
| E — Extractor | 438, 442, 444, 452, 464 | 8 | 3 | 5 / 19 |
| T — Salvage Tool | 439, 443, 450, 456, 459, 462, 463, 465, 467, 470 | 3 | 2 | 5 / 19 |
| R — Recovery Rig | 670 | 50 | 25 | 5 / 19 |

### F — Manual separation Refiner

A **16 × 12 × 5-inch** handled steel sorting/sieving assembly with **12 × 8 × 3-inch usable receiving space**, limited to **5 lb and0.15ft³ of contents**. It includes a2-lb frame, two removable fixed screens totaling1lb with **1/8-inch and1/32-inch apertures**, a2-lb catch pan,0.5-lb brush and0.5-lb scoop. All6lb are included; it has no lid or sealed-fluid storage.

Both hands manually work the assembly over actual stable support. It can separate physically compatible loose components from accessible nonhazardous debris during dismantling. It is not a furnace, acid bath, ore-concentrating engine, spell filter or post-hoc second salvage roll. Materials that pass through both screens need a genuinely suitable separate receiver and method; no missing fraction is retained by magic.

Original frame, screen frames/mesh and catch pan are the primary body. Brush, scoop, grips and minor fittings can be replaced compatibly. Setup/positioning takes **one active minute**; putting it away takes one. No power, fuel or consumable starts inside it.

### K — Complete Salvaging Kit

Bind one actual **25-gp/5-lb Salvager’s-tools kit**, not another free copy of that kit. Its NEW explicit decomposition is: fitted leather case1lb; separation hand tools2lb; two shallow steel trays0.5lb each; lidded mundane steel box1lb. Hand tools are ten-inch pliers0.75lb, flat driver0.25lb, eight-inch chisel0.5lb, small paring implement0.25lb and tweezers0.25lb.

The case is **14 × 9 × 7 inches outside**, with **13 × 8 × 6-inch fitted interior**. It stores the named equipment, not an additional unrecorded cargo allowance. Each tray is **9 × 6 × 1 inches outside**, with **8.5 × 5.5 ×0.75-inch interior**, and allows **1 lb/0.015ft³**. The box is **7 × 5 × 5 inches outside**, **6 × 4 × 4 inches inside**, with the existing **1-lb/0.05ft³ contents cap**. Both mass and volume/shape apply.

The original pliers’ body/jaws, driver shaft, chisel body and box shell/lid are primary. Compatible case, trays, paring implement, tweezers, grips and minor closures can be replaced. The complete required set is necessary for the magical whole-kit function. Operating separation tools have steel load-bearing defenses; the separately targeted leather case is not AC19 merely by association.

Both hands are committed to actual tool work and specimen control. Opening/arranging the kit takes **one active minute** and packing takes one. Its proper implements can satisfy the dismantling/creation task’s actual tool, tray and box requirements without buying a duplicate. Contents, proficiency and missing primary members are not conjured. An integral implement’s use is the kit’s one effect, not a separate enchanted effect per implement.

### S — Manual Separator

An **18 × 12 × 8-inch** steel screw-and-wedge bench frame, with **14 × 8-inch supported bed**, **six-inch maximum jaw opening** and **three-inch separation travel**. Maximum material supported by it is **10 lb**. It includes frame4lb, screw/jaw assembly2lb, anchor clamps1lb and removable receiving tray1lb. The tray is **8 × 6 × 2 inches outside**, **7 × 5 ×1.5 inches inside**, capped at **2 lb/0.03ft³**; its contents also count toward any shared supported load.

Use both hands and a stable bench to which its real clamps fit, with a **maximum three-inch bench-edge thickness**. It separates compatible accessible joints or supported assemblies through manual force. It cannot automatically split welded or enchanted bonds, pull hidden components through an intact shell, or stabilize a magical essence. The operator’s actual force, access and object compatibility remain required; the geometry is no guaranteed extraction rate.

Original frame, drive screw and main jaws are primary. Compatible anchor clamps, tray, grip pads and minor fittings may be replaced. Mounting takes **two active minutes**, dismounting takes two. It requires no fuel because it is manual, not because it generates power.

### E — Manual Extractor

A **12 × 6 × 3-inch**,3-lb steel hand puller with integral crossbar, screw and paired jaws. Jaw admission is **0.25–4 inches**, with **two-inch travel**. It can grip/support an actually compatible component of at most **5 lb**; other connected material needs independent real support. No container is included.

Both hands operate and stabilize it. It can remove fitted ordinary parts when their actual geometry, fastening and required force permit. It grants no lifting multiplier, suction, telekinesis, biological extraction permission or source access through obstacles. The original crossbar, screw and paired jaws are primary; grips and minor fittings may be replaced. Ordinary item-access rules apply; no separate deployment time or free material receipt is added.

### T — General Salvage Tool

A **12 × 3 × 2-inch**,2-lb steel hand implement with plier jaws and an integral flat prying/scraping end. One hand manipulates it and the other controls supported work. Its jaws open at most **two inches**. No container, new force rating, hand-free use or universal cutting permission is included.

It permits compatible manual unfastening, prying and separation on accessible mundane assemblies. The original steel body, hinge and jaws are primary; compatible grips/minor fittings may be replaced. It is neither an Essence Collector nor an automatic Recycler despite preserved legacy names. Access follows ordinary item handling; no special activation Action creates its bonus.

### R — Manual Recovery Rig

A **30 × 20 × 20-inch** bench-mounted steel jig with **24 × 14-inch bed**, **20 × 12 × 10-inch clear work envelope**, **eight-inch jaw opening** and **six-inch manual screw travel**. It supports at most **50 lb total workpiece/contents load** within its actual geometry. It has no vertical hoist, independent movement, unattended mode or external power output.

Its25lb comprises base/frame12lb, drive screw6lb, jaws/clamps4lb, two receiving trays2lb total and fitted spacers/straps1lb. Each tray is **12 × 8 × 3 inches outside**, **11 × 7 × 2 inches inside**, capped at **5 lb/0.07ft³**. Contents count toward the rig’s actual support load if supported by it. A tray is not a sealed containment vessel.

Both hands of the lead operate the crank and controls; necessary ancillary handling is sequential or done by actual capable helpers without creating an assistant bonus. Original base/frame, drive screw and main jaws are primary. Compatible clamps, trays, spacers, straps and minor fittings can be replaced. Mounting takes **five additional active minutes before dismantling**; dismounting/packing takes **five afterward**. Its fitted clamps require a stable compatible bench edge no thicker than **four inches** and real support for rig plus load.

“Eternal-Actuator” provides no power supply, perpetual operation or replacement actuator. The consumed source component remains part of that recipe’s required process, not a reusable generator or a surviving separately claimable organ inside every finished rig.

### Shared physical limits and auxiliary station

Capacity covers what a body actually supports/contains at one time. Sequential portions can be handled within one work order only when that real workflow fits its required labor; body capacity does not multiply hourly throughput or create extra rolls. A single oversize indivisible component cannot be made compatible by relabeling it a series of portions. External supported material remains actual mass/cargo, not invisible contents.

F/K/S pre-check arrangement can occupy the normal setup part of the one-hour task when it fits; extra required setup is additional labor. Setup alone never supplies the qualifying operation minute. Post-task packing is additional and does not delay the already resolved claim. R’s stated five-minute mounting/dismounting is additional even if other setup is also needed. Rest, guarding and another order cannot use those same active minutes.

The whole-body HP5 track never becomes5HP per constituent. A missing necessary member can disable a kit at positive aggregateHP. A pin, mesh thread or jaw seam is not independently targetable without an actual preexisting separable-object profile. Use ordinary material compatibility, Sunder targeting and carried-item rules. Broken bodies and spilled contents retain their actual locations, mass and history.

**NEW optional ordinary Salvage Table:**10gp,25lb, structuralHP20/woodAC15, **48 × 30-inch top at30-inch working height**, **100-lb supported load including every item placed on it**, two-inch edge. Packed dimensions **50 × 8 × 6 inches**; deployed outer dimensions **50 × 32 × 30 inches**. Unfolding or packing takes five active minutes, two hands, outside recipe/dismantling labor unless already deployed. It supplies no tools, heat, storage, protection or bonuses. A real existing compatible station can satisfy the requirement instead; ordinary field dismantling still accepts A1’s suitable stable surface without compulsory ownership of this table.

## GT-V04 — NEW Precision Dismantling critical bridge

**Affected: tool-assisted dismantling using these42 recipes; the critical-quality permission operates only for462–470 and669–671. Sources: A1’s binary exception and D1’s literal critical clause.**

**Preserve basic dismantling unchanged:** one active hour for one eligible mundane item of at most50lb, trained INT/WIS plus applicable lawful contributions, DC10, binary meet-DC success,25% recovery on success and none on failure; no natural-die degree shifts. The item is irreversibly dismantled on either result. There is no generic damaged-unit preservation benefit, critical extra unit or harvesting mishap.

**NEW tool-assisted route:** declare this route before destructive commitment and register the actual compatible magical candidates. It retains the same ordinary target restriction, trained lead, **DC10 and sixty active minutes**. Eligible item bonuses and replacement recovery ceilings can apply.
